_comment: Ranked free / 'boosted' brawlers — the maxed brawlers everyone may use in Ranked this season, scraped from the release-notes 'Ranked' section by backend/bsdraft/collect/boosted.py (the boosted-watch CI job). 'active' is the current season; the serving layer resolves the names to ids and treats them as owned-at-full-loadout when personalizing. Hand-editable. 'valid_until' is the LAST day the active rotation is served (inclusive); after it the loader serves no free brawlers until a new season is promoted here — when Season 2 goes live, move it from 'upcoming' to 'active' and clear or extend 'valid_until'.
